name: Tip and bill splitting
description: Tip amount, total, and each person’s share.
solve: function solve(q){const t=q.toLowerCase().replace(/,(?=\d{3})/g,'');const pct=t.match(/(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*(%|percent)/);const ppl=t.match(/(\d+)\s*(people|persons|friends|ways|of us|guests)/)||t.match(/split\s+(\d+)\s*ways/)||t.match(/between\s+(\d+)/);const amt=t.match(/\$\s*(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)/)||t.match(/(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*(dollars|bill|check|total)/)||t.match(/(?:bill|check|cheque|total)\s*(?:of|is|was)?\s*\$?\s*(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)/);if(!amt)return{answer:null,reason:'Need the bill amount.'};const B=+amt[1],p=pct?+pct[1]:(/tip/.test(t)?18:0),n=ppl?+ppl[1]:1;const tip=B*p/100,tot=B+tip,each=tot/n;const f=v=>v.toLocaleString('en-US',{minimumFractionDigits:2,maximumFractionDigits:2});return{answer:`tip ${f(tip)}, total ${f(tot)}${n>1?`, ${f(each)} each`:''}`,steps:[`Tip = ${B} × ${p}% = ${f(tip)}`,`Total = ${f(tot)}`,n>1?`Each of ${n} pays ${f(tot)} ÷ ${n} = ${f(each)}`:'One payer']}}

what is the tip on a bill of 64.50 at 18 percent
